description: Build the manifest-driven static presentation UI with semantic 22-slide content, responsive deck styling, keyboard/history navigation, accessible diagram equivalents, media fallbacks and reproducible Playwright validation.
steps: Create web/index.html with main/slide landmarks, all 22 article slides, literal text and explicit speaker-note panels; represent workflows with DOM/SVG nodes and relations, and provide alt text plus local captions/transcripts for media.

Create web/styles.css and web/app.js for the dark neon deck visual system, responsive desktop/tablet/mobile reflow, focus-visible/reduced-motion behavior, hash/history navigation, keyboard controls, focus management, panel Escape handling and media error fallbacks.

Create pinned web/package.json tooling, web/tests/smoke.mjs, web/scripts/render-reference.sh and web/README.md; run browser assertions, capture desktop/mobile/narrow screenshots, record console/network/accessibility/overflow/overlap results, and report missing PPTX reference renderer as not-run when applicable.
acceptance_criteria: All 22 hashes load one active article with synchronized title, progress, counter, index aria-current and working previous/next controls.
At 320x568 and 200% zoom content remains reachable without body horizontal overflow or chrome overlap; diagrams retain readable DOM equivalents and keyboard focus is visible.
The smoke report shows no console errors, failed local requests or external hosts, valid manifest text/assets/models, and local video fallback/poster behavior.
Preview and validation commands are documented and run from web/ without a backend.
verification: cd /Users/jsantana/Desktop/github/loop-and-graph-engineering-with-kiro/web && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
Run the documented local-server smoke command and inspect report.json plus desktop-XX.png, mobile-XX.png and narrow-XX.png for all slides.
Manually test keyboard/history/hash-invalid behavior, VoiceOver labels/order, 200% zoom, captions/transcripts, contrast and PPTX reference checklist.
findings: Cross-FEAT integration verification completed. The extractor regenerated assets/manifest.json successfully (`manifest integrity passed: 22 slides, 49 asset references`); independent SHA-256/byte-size/required-poster checks passed for all 49 references, with 22 consecutive slide IDs and slide-8 literal blocks in order. Pinned Playwright 1.52.0 and Chromium installed. A fresh Python server on 127.0.0.1:4173 served only web/ and the documented smoke test passed for all 22 hashes at 1440x900, 768x900 and 320x568: 66 captures, zero failures, console errors or failed local requests. `node --check` passed for app.js and tests/smoke.mjs. `git diff --check` passed for the committed web implementation. `sh scripts/render-reference.sh artifacts/reference` remains not-run because soffice/libreoffice is unavailable. Manual VoiceOver, keyboard/history/hash-invalid, 200% zoom, contrast, playback/captions and PPTX comparison remain explicitly not-run in report.json; no completion claim is made for those manual checks. No files outside web/ were changed by this convergence step.
